Backtracking: include or skip each element. O(2^n).

For subsets basic I will build the partial subset incrementally.

```python
def subsets(nums):
    out = []
    def rec(i, cur):
        if i == len(nums):
            out.append(cur[:]); return
        cur.append(nums[i])
        rec(i + 1, cur)
        cur.pop()
        rec(i + 1, cur)
    rec(0, [])
    return out
```
